friends.name: Cat in the tree
friends.msg: I'm stuck here and lonely... got any treats?

friends.name: Lonely Bunny
friends.msg: I lost my family's flower patch...

friends.name: Sad Bird
friends.msg: My nest fell apart! Bring me treats?

friends.name: Shy Hedgehog
friends.msg: I'm too shy to come out... bring me treats?

friends.name: Old Tortoise
friends.msg: It's been so quiet around here lately.

friends.name: Sunny the Cat
friends.msg: Ooh, are those treats for me?

friends.name: Hoppy Bunny
friends.msg: I'd love a snack, thank you!

friends.name: Chirpy Bird
friends.msg: Tweet! Any treats to share?

npcs.name: Marla the Merchant
npcs.greeting: Lovely day for a stroll! Fresh biscuits and ribbons here.

npcs.name: Nella the Nurse
npcs.greeting: Hello, dear pup!

quest.offer: Oh, hello dear! My little pups are so hungry — could you fetch me 3 🦴 bones?
quest.ready: Three whole bones? You're a darling — may I take them?
quest.progress: Still hunting for bones? I need 3 in all. Thank you, pup!
quest.done: Bless you! The pups are chewing away happily now. 💛

npcs.name: Wade the Wader
npcs.greeting: Morning, pup!

quest.offer: The two ducks out on the ponds hardly get any visitors. Would you paddle over and say hello to both of them?
quest.ready: You met both ducks? They'll be quacking about it all day!
quest.progress: Just {remaining} more duck to greet — they're out on the ponds.
quest.done: The ponds feel friendlier already. Thank you, pup! 🦆

npcs.name: Acorn
npcs.greeting: Psst — up here!

quest.offer: Two shy squirrels are hiding in the tall grass. Could you go and greet them both to cheer them up?
quest.ready: Both squirrels? How lovely of you!
quest.progress: {remaining} squirrel is still waiting for a hello.
quest.done: They're chattering away happily now — thank you! 🐿️

quest.label: Cheer up every friend in the field

friends.name: Prickle the Hedgehog
friends.msg: Oh! You startled me... got a treat?

friends.name: Shelly the Tortoise
friends.msg: Slow day in the orchard, isn't it?

friends.name: Clover Bunny
friends.msg: These apples aren't ripe yet...

friends.name: Robin the Bird
friends.msg: Chirp! My nest could use some cheer.

npcs.name: Marla the Merchant
npcs.greeting: Stock up before the trail, pup — biscuits keep your hearts full!

npcs.name: Fenwick the Tailor
npcs.greeting: Heading for the mountains? Let's find you something warm to wear!

npcs.name: Pippa the Orchard Keeper
npcs.greeting: Oh, a visitor!

quest.offer: A few new faces have wandered into the orchard. Would you welcome all three of them with a friendly hello?
quest.ready: You met everyone? They already feel at home!
quest.progress: {remaining} orchard critter still hasn't been greeted.
quest.done: The whole orchard is a little cheerier now. Thank you, pup! 🍎

quest.label: Cheer up every friend in the orchard

npcs.name: Digby the Mole
npcs.greeting: The Baron? All muscle, no sense, that one. You can't bite him — but he can't stop once he charges. Stand behind one of my covered pits and let him barrel right in. Three good tumbles and he'll quit!

friends.name: Rusty the Fox
friends.msg: The cold nights are so lonely up here...

friends.name: Old Billy Goat
friends.msg: My herd wandered off over the ridge.

friends.name: Hoot the Owl
friends.msg: Whoo will keep me company tonight?

friends.name: Pip the Marmot
friends.msg: I burrowed too far from my friends...

friends.name: Bramble the Cub
friends.msg: I can't find my way back to the den.

friends.name: Ridge the Raven
friends.msg: The peaks are quiet and grey today.

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: Welcome to the valley, pup! Gear up before the wolves catch your scent.

friends.name: Shivering Hare
friends.msg: S-so cold out here... got a treat?

friends.name: Frosted Ptarmigan
friends.msg: Brrr! A snack would warm me right up.

npcs.name: Fenwick the Tailor
npcs.greeting: Cold enough for you? Bundle up before you press on!

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: The pass fires have gone cold. Relight all three and the way opens — mind the wolves.

friends.name: Stranded Marmot
friends.msg: I climbed too high and got stuck! A treat, please?

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: Last stretch before the Baron's kin. Beat back the wolves to open the summit gate — and mind the falling rock.

npcs.name: Cliffside Lookout
npcs.greeting: Last chance to stock up before the top. You'll want a full belly for what's up there.

quest.label: Fight your way to the summit

friends.name: Bristle the Hedgehog
friends.msg: Is someone there? It's so dark...

friends.name: Whisper the Owl
friends.msg: Whoo brings light to my lonely branch?

friends.name: Dusk the Fox
friends.msg: I lost the trail in the gloom...

friends.name: Fern the Bunny
friends.msg: I only come out where it's bright!

npcs.name: Bramble the Alchemist
npcs.greeting: Mind the shadows, pup — things lurk where the lantern-light doesn't reach. A biscuit for the road?

npcs.name: Bramble the Alchemist
npcs.greeting: Deeper in grows a pale Mooncap — I need it for the shrine rite ahead. Fetch it for me? Take an antidote; the spores bite.

npcs.name: The Grove Guardian
npcs.greeting: Old moon-magic sleeps in these lanterns, pup. Light all three of the shrine — mind the shadow that walks — and it will wake the power within you.

npcs.name: Marla the Merchant
npcs.greeting: Fancy meeting you this deep! A snack before the shrine?

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: This is it, pup — the Alpha itself. Dodge its lunge, and when it rears back to howl, hit it hard to break the call. Go get 'em.

npcs.name: The Grove Guardian
npcs.greeting: The old bear wakes, pup. It's slow but heavy — when it rears to slam, get clear of the ring; when it paws the ground, step aside. Show it the moonlight in you.

friends.name: Marooned Kitten
friends.msg: Mrow... the water keeps chasing me up the sand!

friends.name: Basking Seal
friends.msg: *yawn* ...oh, hello. Care to keep me company?

friends.name: Hermit Crablet
friends.msg: I'm just a little crab! Got a snack?

friends.name: Pelican Pete
friends.msg: Squawk! The cove's been quiet today.

friends.name: Shy Sandpiper
friends.msg: Peep! I only come out on the open sand.

npcs.name: Marla's Beach Stall
npcs.greeting: Oh, you made it to the coast! I set up days ago. Sun hats and biscuits, fresh as the surf!

npcs.name: Shelly the Beachcomber
npcs.greeting: Find me shells 🐚 and I'll trade you treasures the tide gave up. Dig the sands when the water's out!

npcs.name: Lifeguard Gull
npcs.greeting: Read the tide, pup! 🌊 in, the channel's deep water — 🏖️ out, it drains to sand and the shells show. Watch my little gauge up top.

npcs.name: Pip the Postpigeon
npcs.greeting: Coo! The stalls are swamped with orders. Grab one from the order stall and run it over before it melts — I marked the drop with a ▼!

npcs.name: Fenwick the Tailor
npcs.greeting: Boardwalk chic! And for the diving ahead — a pair of flippers, hmm?

friends.name: Clownfish Coily
friends.msg: Blub! Say hi before you dive?

friends.name: Otter Oona
friends.msg: I float on my back all day — join me?

npcs.name: Shelly's Reef Stall
npcs.greeting: Bring me shells 🐚 and I'll fit you a pearl-diver's charm. The pearls glimmer down in the deep basins — dive for them!

npcs.name: Lifeguard Gull
npcs.greeting: That old crab's a tough shell — armored at high tide 🌊, so bait its charge into the rocks to crack it open! At low tide 🏖️ it's exposed. Mind the claw-sweep. Go on, pup!

friends.name: Squirrel Nutkin
friends.msg: So many acorns, so little company!

friends.name: Hedgerow Hattie
friends.msg: The nights are getting long and lonely.

friends.name: Wagon Pony
friends.msg: Neigh! A treat for a tired old workhorse?

npcs.name: Marla's Autumn Stall
npcs.greeting: Oh, you made it to the orchard! I set up days ago. Cider and biscuits, warm as the season!

npcs.name: Cookpot Keeper
npcs.greeting: Gather 🎃 pumpkins, 🍎 apples and 🌿 herbs from the patch, then bring them to my pot and I'll show you how to cook a buff dish. Warm food, warm heart!

npcs.name: The Keeper
npcs.greeting: Hoo. I am the Keeper of tales, pup. Every friend you cheer and beast you meet, I write in the bestiary — press B to read it anytime. The orchard remembers kindness — welcome home.

quest.label: Gather and cook a harvest dish

friends.name: Lost Farmhand's Pup
friends.msg: *whimper* I can't find the way out of the maze...

npcs.name: Trapped Farmhand
npcs.greeting: Thank goodness, a friendly face! The scarecrows wake after dark. Pull the three gate levers to open the way to town — I'll lend you my lantern's courage.

friends.name: Mill Cat
friends.msg: Mrrp. Mind the moths, they're everywhere tonight.

npcs.name: Fenwick the Tailor
npcs.greeting: Back for an upgrade? Help the town and I'll fit you finer gear. The harvest cloak's reserved for folk the town trusts.

npcs.name: Miller Mabel
npcs.greeting: The cider shift is on and we're short-handed! Work the presses to keep the mill running — every barrel helps the town.

quest.offer: While you're at it, would you say hello to our Mill Cat? A little cheer goes a long way here.
quest.ready: You met the cat? Bless you — the town warms to you.
quest.progress: Just say hello to the Mill Cat when you can, dear.
quest.done: The town's glad to have you, pup. 💛

npcs.name: The Keeper
npcs.greeting: The Scarecrow King rises on harvest night, pup. He summons straw minions, sweeps the field with fire, and gobbles your buff-foods — so cook a spare! Break his call when he rears up. Go on.

friends.name: Fennec Finn
friends.msg: *pant pant* So hot out here... a treat, friend?

friends.name: Weary Camel
friends.msg: I've walked the dunes for days. Company, please?

friends.name: Dune Lizard
friends.msg: I bask on the warm sand — say hello?

npcs.name: Marla's Caravan
npcs.greeting: Oh, you crossed the dunes! I set up days ago. Keep a 🧴 canteen handy and mind the sandstorms!

npcs.name: Relic Vendor
npcs.greeting: Curios from the old ruins, pup — active relics you trigger with the F key. Come to the oasis and I'll fit you your first!

npcs.name: Stranded Traveler
npcs.greeting: Bless you for stopping — the oasis kept me alive. Rest in the shade of the rocks and palms; the heat gauge refills there and at the water.

friends.name: Parrot Pim
friends.msg: Squawk! Welcome to the oasis, traveler!

friends.name: Tortoise Sage
friends.msg: Rest a while, young pup. The desert is patient.

friends.name: Oasis Frog
friends.msg: Ribbit! Cool water, isn't it lovely?

npcs.name: Relic Vendor
npcs.greeting: Here you are! Take this Sand-Stepper charm — equip it in your bag, then tap F to dash. Come back for a decoy or a sun lantern.

quest.offer: Say hello to the Tortoise Sage across the water and I'll gift you your first relic — a dash-charm to slip the desert's dangers.
quest.ready: You met the Sage! Here — a Sand-Stepper Charm. Equip it and press F!
quest.progress: The old Sage is just across the oasis — go say hello.
quest.done: May it carry you through the ruins, pup. 💨

npcs.name: The Archaeologist
npcs.greeting: The ruins to the east hide an ancient mechanism — pressure plates and glyph doors. Bring your relics; you'll need them to solve it.

npcs.name: Fenwick the Tailor
npcs.greeting: Desert-proof gear, fresh in! A wide-brim hat slows the heat.

npcs.name: The Archaeologist
npcs.greeting: The mechanism sleeps within. Step on every glyph plate to light it — and route the sun-beam onto the crystal by turning the mirror (↻). The doors open when all glyphs glow. Mind the trapped tiles and sentinels!

npcs.name: The Archaeologist
npcs.greeting: The Sand Serpent! It dives — armored underground — and surfaces to strike. Drop a 🏺 mirage decoy or lure it over a plate to bait it up, then hit it hard. Go, pup!

friends.name: Snow Hare
friends.msg: B-brrr! A treat would warm me right up.

friends.name: Arctic Fox
friends.msg: The flats are so cold and quiet lately.

npcs.name: Fenwick the Tailor
npcs.greeting: The endgame cold, pup! A warm coat cuts the chill — and keep firewood 🪵 on hand to stoke your warmth in a pinch.

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: Good to see you again, pup! The waystation fires have gone cold. Relight all three to warm a path across the flats — and mind the frost wolves and the slick ice.

npcs.name: The Hermit
npcs.greeting: Few come this far, pup. Drive off the frost-wolf pack and bring me their ❄️ frost crystals — I'll forge you gear fit for the summit.

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: Last stop before the summit, pup. Fight through the cave to the top gate — mind the thin ice (keep moving!) and the falling shards. Here, a feast for the road.

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: The Ice Yeti itself, pup! It ground-pounds shockwave rings — dodge between them — and freezes you if you're close. When the blizzard whips up, keep to the fires and unleash your Ultimate. Go get 'em!

npcs.name: Marla's Sky Stall
npcs.greeting: All the way up here! I set up days ago, naturally. A glide charm for the climb? Ride the updrafts ▲ to cross the gaps — fall and the wind just carries you back!

friends.name: Cloud Lamb
friends.msg: Baa! We made it to the sky together!

friends.name: Sky Sparrow
friends.msg: Tweet! What a view from up here!

friends.name: Sun Hedgehog
friends.msg: The whole journey led here, didn't it?

npcs.name: Marla the Merchant
npcs.greeting: The whole gang made it up here, pup! One last stock-up before the peak.

npcs.name: The Sky Smith
npcs.greeting: Forged from cloud-iron and starlight — legendary gear for the final climb. You've earned it.

npcs.name: Rusk the Ranger
npcs.greeting: Never thought a meadow pup would come this far. Proud of you, kid. The Storm Eagle waits beyond the peak — go show it the heart in you.

npcs.name: Rusk's Voice
npcs.greeting: This is it, pup. Straight up through the storm to the peak gate. Watch the lightning ⚡ — it telegraphs before it strikes. We're all with you.
